2608.06940.title: Blind to the Pivotal Vote: Aggregate Independence Metrics Miss Where Verification Actually Helps
2608.06940.paper_summary: LLM judge panels are a standard evaluation tool, but prior work reports highly correlated panel errors: nine judges provide roughly the effective information of two independent ones, and aggregation closes only a small fraction of the gap. A natural remedy--a signal from a different evidence source, e.g., executing a test suite--produced no distinguishable change in the panel's effective-vote count at scale (-0.04, 95\% CI [-0.10, +0.02]). Aggregate dependence and conditional decision utility are different questions. Elementary majority arithmetic fixes the affected set for single-ballot substitution: only decisions with a one-vote margin can change. The empirical question is whether panel error rates rise and useful substitutions concentrate there. They do: the entire accuracy gain concentrates on these pivotal queries, where it is large (+10.4 to +23.3 percentage points across three headline configurations), and is exactly zero elsewhere. We confirm the pattern across three code benchmarks and four panel sizes (a 9-judge extension and 56 dependent subsampling checks, gain +6.5 to +16.1 percentage points). On HumanEval+/MBPP+, a majority-side replacement rule raises overall accuracy from 82.44\% to 85.62\% while invoking the signal on 16.2\% of queries; signal-only remains stronger at 87.60\%. Thus population-level dependence diagnostics and margin-stratified utility are complementary, and the affected-set characterization yields a call-reduction rule for any specified single-ballot substitution policy.
2608.06940.paper_summary_zh: LLM 評審小組是標準的評估工具，但先前的研究報告顯示小組錯誤高度相關：九位評審提供的有效信息大約相當於兩位獨立評審，而聚合僅縮小了小部分差距。自然的解決方案——來自不同證據來源的信號，例如執行測試套件——在規模上對小組的有效投票數量沒有顯著變化（-0.04，95\% CI [-0.10, +0.02]）。聚合依賴性和條件決策效用是不同的問題。基本的多數算術修正了單次投票替代的受影響集：只有以一票優勢的決策可以改變。實證問題是小組錯誤率是否上升且有用的替代集中於此。確實如此：整個準確度增益集中在這些關鍵查詢上，增益幅度很大（在三個主要配置中從 +10.4 到 +23.3 個百分點），而在其他地方則恰好為零。我們在三個代碼基準和四個小組規模（包括 9 位評審的擴展和 56 次依賴子抽樣檢查，增益 +6.5 到 +16.1 個百分點）中確認了這一模式。在 HumanEval+/MBPP+ 上，多數側替代規則將整體準確度從 82.44\% 提升至 85.62\%，同時在 16.2\% 的查詢中引入信號；僅信號的準確度仍然更強，達到 87.60\%。因此，人口層級的依賴診斷和邊際分層效用是互補的，受影響集的特徵化為任何指定的單次投票替代政策提供了一個呼叫減少規則。
2608.06940.author: Yang Shu et.al.
